entities.summary: Samuel Animashaun Perry  , known professionally as Broda Shaggi  , is a Nigerian comedian, actor, songwriter and musician. He is a two-time Best Actor in a Comedy, Movie or TV Series winner at the Africa Magic Viewers' Choice Awards in 2022 and 2023.
